title: The DI going in
caption: The modelled guitar every high-gain clip plays: palm-muted chugs on the low E, power chords and a short line, as a humbucker and cable deliver it.

title: Blackface clean
caption: Amp Designer, Blackface clean, 2 × 6V6 fixed bias. Volume 3, open chords on single coils, 1x12 open-back cabinet.

title: Tweed breakup
caption: Amp Designer, Tweed breakup, no negative feedback. Volume 7, power chords on a humbucker, 1x12 open-back cabinet.

title: Plexi crunch
caption: Amp Designer, Plexi crunch, 2 × EL34. Volume 7, power chords on a humbucker, 4x12 slant cabinet.

title: Chime
caption: Amp Designer, Chime, 4 × EL84 with no feedback. Volume 5, open chords on single coils, 2x12 closed cabinet.

title: British high gain
caption: Amp Designer, British high gain (3 stages), 2 × EL34. Gain 6, the metal riff, 4x12 cabinet.

title: Modern high gain
caption: Amp Designer, Modern high gain (4 stages), 2 × 6L6GC. Gain at noon, tightness normal, the metal riff, 4x12 cabinet.

title: Extreme high gain
caption: Amp Designer, Extreme high gain (5 stages), 4 × 6L6GC. Gain at noon, tightness tight, the metal riff, 4x12 cabinet.

title: Tightness: fat
caption: Modern high gain with tightness set to fat: more bass reaches the distortion, so the chugs bloom.

title: Tightness: djent
caption: Modern high gain with tightness set to djent: the bass is cut before the distortion and put back after it, so every chug stops dead.

title: Three-knob overdrive
caption: The bundled three-knob overdrive pedal (drive 7, tone 5) in front of the Blackface clean amp at volume 3. Both boards are simulated.

title: Tight Boost into British high gain
caption: The Metal Tight Boost pedal (drive down, level up, tight at noon) in front of the British high-gain amp. Compare it with the amp alone.

title: High-Gain Distortion pedal
caption: The Metal High-Gain Distortion pedal (gain 7, EQ at noon) into the Blackface clean amp, the way a distortion pedal is usually played.
